Name: Move It
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
With this mod you can select and move various things with simple button presses.

To pick up something, hold down the mod key (default [b]Left Alt[/b]) and press the move key (default [b]Left Mouse[/b]). You will hear a sound if the item has been picked up.

To place a picked up thing, press the move key without holding down the mod key.

To cancel picking up, press the cancel key (default [b]Esc[/b]).

The following things can be moved with this mod:

[list]
[*]Characters
[*]Monsters
[*]Farm Animals
[*]Buildings

[*]Tilled Earth (with Crops)
[*]Stumps and Boulders
[*]Giant Crops
[*]Bushes
[*]Placed Craftables
[*]Stones, Sticks, Weeds, etc.
[*]Trees
[/list]

[size=5][b]Notes[/b][/size]

Many of the game's bushes and trees are not actually bushes or trees, they are part of the map and cannot be moved with this mod.

Moving villagers that are already moving will most often mess up their pathing.



[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.
